info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Loan Loan Product-spec
info.description: The Loan Product Creation API enables businesses to introduce and define new loan products within their financial services platform. This endpoint facilitates the submission of essential details such as interest rates, loan terms, and eligibility criteria, thereby enriching the product portfolio. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers aiming to expand their offerings. By utilizing this API, organizations can quickly adapt to market needs and enhance customer satisfaction through innovative lending solutions.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new loan product by providing the necessary details. Ensure that all required parameters are included in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new loan product. Ensure that all required fields are provided and formatted correctly to successfully process the request.

201.description: Resource created successfully. The new loan product is available for use.
